A Vision Dictionary

Version history

All updates are consolidated into the current release.

Version 3.0.71

September 25, 2026

Power Rankings now displays the top four technicians.

  • Fourth-place visibilityThe technician ranking screen and saved technician ranking image now include positions one through four.
  • Ranking logic preservedThis changes only the number of displayed technician leaders; scoring, eligibility, ordering, and tie handling remain unchanged.

Version 3.0.70

September 25, 2026

Added the Halloween theme with a dark stained-glass look and a themed award outfit.

  • Halloween themeDeep plum panels, warm moonlight, pumpkin-orange accents, crooked hills, and original stained-glass artwork now carry across app headers, controls, Daily Tasks, BM/PD Log Search, and PM Log.
  • Themed award characterThe existing mascot keeps its face, helmet, goggles, antenna, pose, and trophy while gaining a pinstripe tailcoat, bat-wing bow tie, stitched cuffs, spiral trim, and pumpkin buttons whenever Halloween is active.
  • Readable dark interfaceTask cards and form controls stay calm and high-contrast so the decorative theme does not add clutter to the working areas.

Version 3.0.69

September 24, 2026

PM records now use a separate shared history and can no longer enter the BM/PD downtime log.

  • Separated submission pathsPM submissions are saved with their Daily Tasks shift while the existing Google endpoint is reserved for BM/PD submissions.
  • Searchable PM historyThe PM Log includes a collapsible date-range and keyword search across completed PM records.
  • Clear save confirmationThe success message confirms that PM history and shift points were updated without using the BM/PD log.

Version 3.0.68

September 24, 2026

BM/PD Log Search now matches the active app theme and uses a simpler filter bar.

  • Consistent themed headerThe search page keeps the same hero colors, title treatment, settings placement, and theme artwork as the rest of the app.
  • Focused search controlsRemoved the minimum and maximum downtime fields while retaining keyword, date range, sort order, refresh, and CSV import tools.

Version 3.0.67

September 24, 2026

Refined MI2 Daily Tasks into a cleaner, task-first workspace.

  • Clear three-step flowShift setup, score details, and active tasks now have a stronger visual hierarchy with compact collapsible sections.
  • Less on-screen clutterThe score breakdown and live report preview stay tucked away until opened, while the essential shift progress remains visible.
  • Faster task navigationA simplified filter toolbar, calmer section cards, and responsive spacing make the checklist easier to scan and use on phones and desktops.

Version 3.0.66

September 23, 2026

Top 3 NG entries now show Line before Vision in the form, preview, and copied report.

Version 3.0.65

September 23, 2026

Top 3 NG comments now appear in parentheses on their own line below the corresponding NG rate or Major NG value in previews and copied reports.

Version 3.0.64

September 23, 2026

Collapsed PKG Update comments behind Add comment controls and simplified the Lead Align heading. Saved comments remain available through Edit comment and remain in copied reports.

Version 3.0.63

September 23, 2026

Collapsed optional NG rate and Major NG comments behind Add comment controls in all Top 3 NG entries. Entered comments remain in the copied report when collapsed.

Version 3.0.62

September 23, 2026

Added PH to MI2 PKG IQ Checks and aligned preview results beneath their vision headers. Compact copied text and line selection are retained.

Version 3.0.61

September 23, 2026

Updated the v3.0.59 PKG IQ tool with compact plain-text reports, line selection, MI1 PH checks, and the X-R heading.

Version 3.0.59

September 23, 2026

Added PKG IQ Checks to Copy/Paste with MI1/MI2 machine lists, MI1 X-ray checks, tap-to-toggle results, building-specific drafts, and copy-ready reports.

Version 3.0.58

September 23, 2026

Separated Tolay, Karla, Zack, and Esme from technician rankings and Top 3 cards. Admin tables show leads at the bottom with their separate lead rank in parentheses, including the balanced trial.

Version 3.0.57

September 23, 2026

Updated the Admin trial to Core work 20%, Escalations 20%, Avg PPS 20%, and Medals, Error proofing, Super escalations, and PMs at 10% each.

Version 3.0.56

September 23, 2026

Added an Admin-only balanced ranking trial with weighted activity categories, split task credit, five-shift eligibility, and official-versus-trial movement. Official ranking calculations remain unchanged.

Version 3.0.55

September 23, 2026

Admin-only detailed technician and shift rankings with current points, averages, work counts, and achievements. Removed PM before-and-after comparisons.

Version 3.0.54

September 22, 2026

PMs now earn 25 points each, including recalculated historical reports and rankings.

  • PM impact comparisonPower Rankings compares 50 vs 25 points for technicians and shifts using the same server records, shared credit, and qualification rules.

Version 3.0.53

September 14, 2026

Protected Power Rankings from orphaned, duplicate, or malformed Firebase shift records.

  • Canonical shift IDs onlyA record can affect Power Rankings only when its Firebase document ID exactly matches its saved date and shift in YYYY-MM-DD_SHIFT format.
  • Phantom records blockedLegacy or duplicate documents with mismatched IDs are ignored even when their internal date and shift fields would otherwise place them in the ranking period.
  • Admin integrity auditPower Rankings now show Admin the document ID, date, shift, completion, points, and Counted/Excluded/Ignored reason for every server record checked.

Version 3.0.52

September 14, 2026

Moved the official September Power Rankings start date to September 5.

  • September cutoff adjustedSeptember 2026 rankings now default to September 5 instead of September 7.
  • 70% rule retainedOnly shifts completing at least 70% of available work can affect Power Rankings.
  • Future months unchangedBeginning in October, monthly Power Rankings automatically start on the first day of the calendar month.

Version 3.0.51

September 14, 2026

Set the official September Power Rankings period to begin after the MI2 Daily Tasks rollout.

  • September cutoffSeptember 2026 rankings default to September 7 instead of September 1 so early rollout days do not affect standings.
  • Future months unchangedBeginning in October, monthly Power Rankings automatically return to the first day of the calendar month.
  • Transparent rollout noteThe rankings page explains the September 7 cutoff while the existing 70% shift-completion requirement remains in effect.

Version 3.0.50

September 14, 2026

Added a 70% completion requirement before a shift can affect Power Rankings.

  • 70% qualification ruleA shift must complete at least 70% of available work before it counts toward Shifts Worked, Avg PPS, total ranking points, or ranking eligibility.
  • Low-completion shifts excludedShifts below 70% remain saved in history and reports, but no longer distort technician or shift Power Rankings.
  • Visible verificationThe live ranking status now shows how many loaded shift records meet the 70% minimum.

Version 3.0.49

September 14, 2026

Made Power Rankings verify fresh shared data instead of reusing an old ranking snapshot.

  • Server-verified rankingsPower Rankings now query the shared Firebase server directly so an offline or stale local cache cannot silently change the ranking order.
  • Automatic freshnessRankings refresh every time the page is opened and again when the app returns to the foreground.
  • Visible refresh proofThe ranking status shows the update time and the exact number of shift records loaded; failed refreshes clearly warn that displayed results may be stale.

Version 3.0.48

September 14, 2026

Renamed the existing production tracker to MI2 Daily Tasks.

  • Clear MI2 identityThe existing Daily Tasks tab, page heading, home tile, and browser title now identify the tracker as MI2 Daily Tasks.
  • Existing data protectedInternal routes, element IDs, shift-history keys, and shared synchronization identifiers are unchanged, so current MI2 records continue to load normally.
  • Ready for MI1The naming now leaves a clear path for a separate MI1 Daily Tasks tab with its own trackers in a future update.

Version 3.0.47

September 14, 2026

Added automatic stale-version and shared-sync safety warnings.

  • Outdated build warningThe hosted app checks the deployed index with a cache-busting request and prompts the user to refresh when a newer app version is available.
  • Sync health warningCloud errors, offline status, and unusually long pending sync states trigger a clear popup so technicians know the phone backup may not yet be shared.
  • Single version sourceThe Daily Tasks sync panel now reads the app version from the version metadata instead of a hard-coded label.

Version 3.0.46

September 14, 2026

Added required requester tracking to manual escalations.

  • Requested ByManual escalation entries now include a text field identifying who requested the work.
  • Required submission fieldsProcess, Machine, Vision, Requested By, and Completed By must all be filled before a manual escalation can be saved.
  • Saved with historyRequested By is retained through drafts, cloud sync, restored shifts, and escalation reports without altering existing historical entries.

Version 3.0.45

September 14, 2026

Removed manual PM entry from Daily Tasks.

  • PM Log onlyNew PM point entries can now be created only by submitting the dedicated PM Log.
  • No blank PM editorStarting, restoring, or syncing a shift no longer creates a manual PM form in Section 10.
  • History preservedPreviously recorded PM entries remain visible and continue to count at 50 points each.

Version 3.0.44

September 14, 2026

Normalized PM scoring to 50 points across all historical and future shifts.

  • All PM historyEvery completed PM now contributes 50 points, including shifts originally saved while PMs were worth 60.
  • Historical rankings recalculatedReports, Power Rankings, contributor totals, and achievement medal thresholds now evaluate historical PM work at 50 points.
  • Other grandfathered rules retainedHistorical LNS TOP NG, Error Proofing, and escalation scoring continue to follow their existing saved scoring-rule versions.

Version 3.0.43

September 14, 2026

Updated PM and escalation scoring while protecting previously recorded points and achievements.

  • PM scoringNew PM completions earn 50 points instead of 60.
  • Escalation source scoringManual escalation entries earn 25 points; escalations submitted through the BM/PD Log retain the full 50 points.
  • Historical scoring preservedSaved dynamic entries retain the scoring-rule version they were created under, so prior point totals and achievement medals are not recalculated by this update.

Version 3.0.42

September 10, 2026

Embedded the existing Microsoft Cell Tracking form inside Daily Tasks.

  • Dedicated tabCell Tracking now appears beside Daily Tasks, BM/PD Log, and PM Log.
  • Existing Excel sync retainedThe embedded Microsoft Form continues using its current SharePoint Excel response connection.
  • Phone-friendly fallbackOpen Full Screen launches the original form in a separate browser tab whenever more room is needed.

Version 3.0.41

September 10, 2026

Protected technician credit with a controlled roster directory.

  • Shift-specific namesB1, B2, G1, and G2 roster selectors show only the technicians assigned to the selected shift.
  • Complete directoryChoosing Other opens every technician plus supervisors Sergio and James; OT Support uses the same directory.
  • Historical credit protectedSaved custom names still load, and prior Tolayc entries resolve to Tolay for Perfect Shift stars, medals, stats, and Power Rankings.

Version 3.0.40

September 10, 2026

Redesigned Power Rankings as detailed, shareable cards.

  • Complete technician totalsEach top-three card now shows monthly PM, escalation, super escalation, error-proofing, points, medals, and shift details.
  • Position streaksTechnician and shift cards show how many consecutive days each entry has held its current rank.
  • Shareable shift cardsAll four shifts use a compact card layout with complete totals, plus separate phone-friendly PNG saves for technician and shift rankings.

Version 3.0.39

September 10, 2026

Renamed the Leaderboard to Power Rankings.

  • Updated navigationThe home tile and performance page now use the Power Rankings name and PR icon.
  • Clearer languagePage headings, refresh messaging, and the browser title consistently use the new name.
  • Access unchangedTechnicians can still view rankings while custom date controls remain available only to Admin logins.

Version 3.0.38

September 10, 2026

Moved performance standings into a dedicated Leaderboard.

  • Technician accessThe Leaderboard is available from both Technician and Admin logins while Reports remains administrator-only.
  • Protected date controlsTechnicians automatically see the current month through today; only Admin logins can choose a custom date range.
  • Compact shift comparisonThe side-scrolling shift table keeps every metric visible with reduced blank space and tighter rows.

Version 3.0.37

September 10, 2026

Added current-month technician and shift rankings.

  • Top techniciansThe month’s top three technicians show accumulated points, achievement medals, and daily rank movement.
  • Top shiftB1, B2, G1, and G2 are ranked by monthly points with completion, PM, escalation, super escalation, error-proofing, and Perfect Shift totals.
  • Daily movementBoth rankings compare cumulative positions with the prior calendar day while retaining the side-scrolling shift table.

Version 3.0.36

September 10, 2026

Restricted administrative reporting and restored flexible PM entry.

  • Admin-only reportingLive Dashboard, BM/PD Trends, and Reports are hidden and route-protected for technician logins.
  • Manual PM optionSection 10 once again supports manual PM entries, matching the escalation workflow.
  • Draft safety retainedMulti-phone protection continues preserving active PM and escalation forms and edits.

Version 3.0.35

September 10, 2026

Protected active entry forms during multi-phone synchronization.

  • Draft protectionUnfinished PM, Escalation, and Super Escalation values survive shared-cloud refreshes.
  • Edit protectionActive edits, technician selections, focus, and cursor position remain intact while other phones update the shift.
  • Admin privacyVersion history is visible only after an administrator login.

Version 3.0.34

September 7, 2026

Counted achievements in the Top Contributor card.

  • Complete recognitionThe Top Contributor’s Perfect Shift star appears before their name and their individual tier medals appear after it.
  • Tie supportWhen technicians tie for Top Contributor, each name displays its own star and medal history.

Version 3.0.33

September 7, 2026

Perfect Shift stars now lead the technician name.

  • Clear honor orderThe numbered gold star appears before the lead’s name, followed by the name and then any individual achievement medals.

Version 3.0.32

September 7, 2026

Counted Perfect Shift stars for shift leads.

  • Lead recognitionEach 100% B1 shift adds a gold star to Esme, each B2 shift to Karla, and each G2 shift to Tolay. G1 does not award a lead star.
  • Reliable countsStars count distinct qualifying shifts from shared history and the current shift, so refreshes and celebration replays do not inflate totals.
  • Focused displayNumbered stars appear beside the lead’s name only in Allocation completion rates and Share of completed work, alongside any individual medals.

Version 3.0.31

September 7, 2026

Grandfathered scoring protects past shifts and achievements.

  • Historical totals preservedPreviously saved shifts continue using LNS TOP NG at 25 points, Error Proofing at 75 points, and PMs at 50 points.
  • Achievements preservedHistorical medal counts are calculated with each shift’s original scoring rules, so the new point values do not rewrite past achievements.
  • New shifts onlyThe Version 3.0.30 point values apply only to newly created shifts, and each saved shift retains its scoring-rule version.

Version 3.0.30

September 7, 2026

Updated task values and shared Escalation credit.

  • Updated pointsLNS TOP NG Reports are 50 points, Error Proofing checks are 50 points, and completed PMs are 60 points.
  • Escalation teamworkRegular Escalations can credit additional technicians and divide the 50 points evenly, matching the existing Super Escalation workflow.

Version 3.0.29

September 7, 2026

Exclusive achievement tier awards.

  • Highest tier onlyEach technician earns exactly one medal per qualifying shift—the highest tier reached with their own credited task points.
  • No lower-tier duplicatesA Gold shift adds one Gold medal and does not also add Bronze or Silver medals.

Version 3.0.28

September 7, 2026

Smaller ribbon medals in the two technician score sections.

  • Focused placementNumbered honor awards appear only beside names in Allocation completion rates and Share of completed work, including OT contributors.
  • Compact awardsMetal tiers use small ribbon medals with centered counts. Diamond keeps its gemstone shape. All earned tiers display together.

Version 3.0.27

September 7, 2026

Metal medals and a faceted diamond for achievement honors.

  • Metal awardsBronze, silver, gold and platinum badges now have a beveled rim, engraved details and metallic highlights.
  • Diamond awardA blue faceted gemstone replaces the plain circle, with the achievement count centered on the gem.

Version 3.0.26

September 7, 2026

Numbered achievement honors beside technician names.

  • Matching tier colorsSmall bronze, silver, gold, platinum and diamond circles show each technician’s qualifying shift count.
  • Shared historyCounts include saved shared shifts and the current shift, with one credit per tier per date and shift. Corrections recalculate counts; replays never add credits.
  • Daily Tasks and shift previewHonor badges follow names across allocation cards, work contributions, completed tasks and the on-screen shift preview.

Version 3.0.25

September 7, 2026

Five achievement tiers with matching character trophies.

  • Updated thresholds1,000 Bronze · 1,100 Silver · 1,200 Gold · 1,300 Platinum · 1,500 Diamond.
  • Matching recognitionCelebrations, scorecard and report badges, and shareable achievement cards show the current tier and corresponding trophy.
  • Celebration history preservedPreviously celebrated bronze, silver and gold tiers remain remembered without blocking the new Platinum and Diamond awards. Perfect Shift remains available.

Version 3.0.24

September 7, 2026

Animated character celebrations and tiered achievements.

  • Trophy tiers1,000 points earns bronze, 1,250 silver, and 1,500 gold. Badges show the highest current tier and replay the celebration.
  • Perfect ShiftCompleting all required work unlocks a team achievement naming everyone credited with completed work, including OT support. Reading Rate remains optional.
  • Celebrating characterThe mascot bounces and tilts with the matching trophy or team-cheering pose during the 12-second confetti and fireworks celebration. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
  • Shareable cardsBoth individual and team cards include the character, with clean typography, real names, shift dates, and copy/download controls.

Version 3.0.23

September 6, 2026

Version 3.0.23 adds compact completed tasks and 1K Club achievements.

  • Compact completed tasksCompleted tasks keep their grid size, with technician credit and an action menu for editing or deleting completion. Incomplete only hides completed tasks and empty rows.
  • Reading rate scoringCell Tracking Reading Rate still earns total and technician points but does not affect allocation completion percentages or count as missed work.
  • 1K Club celebrationReaching 1,000 points triggers 12 seconds of confetti and fireworks. Tap the gold scorecard badge to replay the celebration anytime, then open the achievement card to copy or download it.
  • Report recognitionQualifying technicians receive gold 1K Club badges in the shift preview and exported report images.

Version 3.0.22

September 6, 2026

Version 3.0.22 places theme and session controls inside each page header and returns the rotating quote to the home screen.

  • Header controlsThe theme selector and logout move with the active page header and scroll out of view naturally with it.
  • Home quoteThe rotating quote appears only on the homepage and changes every 30 seconds.
  • Clear workspaceThe sticky utility bar has been removed so it no longer covers content while users scroll.

Version 3.0.21

September 6, 2026

Version 3.0.21 adds a single-sheet master Excel history for trend analysis.

  • One row per shiftEvery stored date and shift exports as one structured record with roster, completion, points, activity counts, and handoff details.
  • Trend-ready datesDate, Monday week start, and month start are real Excel dates for filtering, pivot tables, and daily, weekly, or monthly grouping.
  • Complete cloud historyThe export rebuilds the workbook from every shared Firebase shift, so each download is a refreshed master file.

Version 3.0.20

September 6, 2026

Version 3.0.20 removes preapproval from shared synchronization and restores automatic administrator recognition.

  • No preapproval requiredEvery verified Google account can connect to shared shifts immediately after signing in.
  • Administrator restoredThe designated administrator is recognized securely by Firebase rules without requiring an authorization document.
  • Anonymous access blockedVisitors must still complete verified Google sign-in, and administrator-only operations remain protected.

Version 3.0.19

September 6, 2026

Version 3.0.19 repairs protected-shift migration and cloud-save confirmation.

  • Legacy shifts upgraded safelyOlder shared shifts are rewritten once as a complete current-format document while preserving remote work and creator metadata.
  • Retry loop stoppedA rejected write now leaves a clear Firebase error instead of immediately returning to “Shared shift protected.”
  • Honest save stateMobile devices now distinguish phone-protected changes from a Firestore-confirmed save.

Version 3.0.18

September 6, 2026

Version 3.0.18 restores Daily Tasks shared synchronization after Google sign-in.

  • Initialization repairedThe Daily Tasks controller now owns its report-language helper, preventing the startup reference error that stopped cloud synchronization.
  • Sync bridge restoredThe Daily Tasks bridge can finish loading so shared Firestore shifts can open, update, and save.
  • Version alignmentThe app, hosted fallback, install start URL, and Firebase guidance now identify version 3.0.18 and Safe Sync v6.1.

Version 3.0.15

September 5, 2026

Version 3.0.15 adds shared Super Escalation credit and removes the visible administrator email.

  • Multiple techniciansSuper Escalations can credit additional Completed By technicians from the active shift roster.
  • Equal point splittingThe 150 points are divided evenly between every selected technician while the shift total remains 150 points.
  • Role-based administrationSafe Sync v6 uses a protected administrator role record instead of a hard-coded email address in the app or rules.

Version 3.0.14

September 5, 2026

Version 3.0.14 simplifies the generated report actions.

  • One email actionEmail report shares the wide shift-report PNG and lets the user choose an email app.
  • Duplicate removedThe overlapping Share report action has been removed.
  • Clear fallbackIf the browser cannot share image attachments, the PNG downloads and an email draft opens.

Version 3.0.13

September 5, 2026

Version 3.0.13 makes dense desktop shift reports shorter and easier to scan.

  • Escalations below PMsPM entries now use the full report width first, with Escalation entries flowing underneath instead of beside them.
  • Adaptive escalation gridShorter escalation lists use three columns, while lists with eight or more entries use four columns per row.
  • Less unused spaceThe new reading order removes the large blank area that appeared when the escalation list was much longer than the PM list.

Version 3.0.12

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.12 adds 150-point Super Escalations to Daily Tasks.

  • Super Escalation menuA dedicated section mirrors the escalation editor with Process, Machine, Vision, Comment, Completed By, edit, and delete controls.
  • 150-point scoringEach saved Super Escalation is worth 150 points in completion, contributor credit, totals, shift history, and exports.
  • Reports and synchronizationSuper Escalations appear in mobile and desktop shift reports and synchronize safely as their own shared collection.

Version 3.0.11

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.11 adds Thickness to the LNS vision menus.

  • Thickness vision choiceThickness is now available when LNS is selected in Daily Tasks PM and escalation entries.
  • Escalation form supportThe standalone Escalation Format LNS vision menu includes the same Thickness choice.

Version 3.0.10

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.10 gives the desktop shift report a cleaner, professional reading order.

  • Summary-first layoutTop Contributor, Work Contribution, and Summary Totals now form one aligned summary row.
  • Activity beneath the summaryPM and escalation entries now flow below the summary row, followed by completed NGM error-proofing work.
  • Prominent shift handoffThe handoff note is displayed in a full-width highlighted panel at the bottom of the image.
  • Desktop sharing availableThe desktop-share control remains visible and downloads the PNG when native file sharing is unavailable.

Version 3.0.9

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.9 gives desktop shift-report images a wider landscape layout.

  • Landscape desktop reportThe report title and three completion metrics now share the first row, leaving more room for report details.
  • Balanced activity columnsPM and escalation entries appear side by side, with PM entries arranged in a compact two-column grid.
  • Compact lower sectionNGM error-proofing entries spread across three columns, with the shift handoff note beside them.

Version 3.0.8

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.8 makes report image sharing reliable across supported phones and computers.

  • Prepared image sharingMobile and desktop report images are created when the report opens, so the Share buttons can launch the system share sheet directly from your tap.
  • Desktop download fallbackA new Download desktop image button saves the wide PNG when the browser cannot share image files.
  • Clear share resultsThe desktop Share button no longer silently sends text when an image cannot be shared.

Version 3.0.7

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.7 reduces clutter in the saved PM and escalation lists.

  • Extra-compact saved rowsSaved entries now place their summary, status, Edit, and Delete controls on one compact row with tighter spacing.
  • Full details preservedLong titles and comments are shortened in the list, while Edit still opens every saved field with its complete value.

Version 3.0.6

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.6 repairs the My Tasks allocation filter.

  • Allocation filteringChoosing Allocation 1, 2, or 3 now hides the other allocations' Black Frame, Cell Tracking, and PKG checks while keeping shared shift tasks visible.
  • Clear selection feedbackThe matching allocation summary card is highlighted while its filter is active.

Version 3.0.5

September 3, 2026

Version 3.0.5 makes signing in and choosing a shift strictly read-only.

  • Load-only shift selectionChoosing a date or shift can only open the matching cloud record. It never queues, creates, or updates a shared shift.
  • User-edit-only creationA missing shift is created only after someone makes a real content change such as checking a task, entering a name, or adding a note.
  • Safe Sync v5The matching Firestore rules reject writes from earlier app builds so a cached copy cannot reintroduce the shift-selection bug.

Version 3.0.4

September 3, 2026

Version 3.0.4 adds server-enforced protection against blank-form replacement and older cached app builds.

  • Safe Sync v4Every cloud write now carries a changing write ID and current sync-protocol version. The matching Firestore rules reject writes from older cached builds, preventing an outdated phone or tab from clearing shared data.
  • Non-destructive openingWhen a shared shift first opens, completed tasks and populated fields from either Firestore or the phone backup are preserved. Blank values never replace populated work during sign-in.
  • Bulk-clear safety stopA write that unexpectedly removes several pieces of shift data at once is blocked and the last confirmed cloud state is restored on screen.

Version 3.0.3

September 2, 2026

Version 3.0.3 prevents a new sign-in or device from replacing an existing shared shift with a blank local form.

  • Cloud-first shift openingThe app waits for a confirmed Firestore server snapshot before allowing queued changes to save, so stale browser cache and blank phone drafts cannot overwrite shared work.
  • Safe first-load mergeIf someone makes a change while the shift is opening, only the fields changed during that loading window are merged into the shared shift; existing task responses, names, notes, PMs, and escalations remain intact.

Version 3.0.2

September 2, 2026

Version 3.0.2 keeps Cell Tracking Reading Rate work visible without lowering the overall shift-completion percentage.

  • Completion scoringCell Tracking Reading Rate checks remain saved, synchronized, reportable, and eligible for allocation and technician points, but they are excluded from the Total shift completion percentage in Daily Tasks, dashboards, and reports.

Version 3.0.1

August 31, 2026

Version 3.0.1 repairs Google sign-in guidance and shared Daily Tasks synchronization.

  • Firebase permissionsThe matching Firestore rules now accept the optional Shift Handoff Note field, so both new and existing shared shifts can save successfully.
  • Google sign-inA downloaded HTML copy now directs users to the hosted app, while mobile pop-up and Firebase errors provide clear recovery instructions.
  • Queued cloud savesTask edits made while a shift is connecting, reconnecting, or changing are retained and saved after the shared shift is ready.

Version 3.0

August 25, 2026

Version 3.0 consolidates the complete mobile production toolkit and adds named Completed By attribution throughout Daily Tasks.

  • Named task attributionLead, Allocation 1–3, and any OT Support names populate Completed By menus. Checking Black Frame, Cell Tracking Reading Rate, or any PKG machine check now reveals its own required Completed By dropdown, so contribution points go to the person who actually performed the work.
  • Local Admin and dashboardA PIN-protected Admin screen can rename, reprice, archive, add, import, and export Daily Tasks. The new local dashboard summarizes the shift saved on the current phone, and the HTML exporter creates a clean standalone template without technician names or shift data.
  • Role-based sign-inThe login menu lists Technician first and Admin second. Technician sessions cannot see or directly open the Admin tab; signing in as Admin with the correct PIN reveals and unlocks the Task Manager.
  • Daily Tasks and scoringDate, Shift, and NGM Error Proofing A/B are required before the checklist unlocks. The standard shift contains 81 scheduled items worth 2,435 base points, plus 50 points for every completed PM and escalation. Allocation completion still tracks the assigned A1, A2, and A3 workload separately from individual contribution.
  • Shift-aware schedulesB2 and G2 automatically move scheduled times forward 12 hours and use the night-shift NGM Error Proofing machine sets. Black Frame, six Cell Tracking checks, 42 PKG machine checks, No Response, nine LNS IQ allocation checks, seven PKG IQ machine checks, six LNS TOP NG checks, and five selected NGM Error Proofing entries are included.
  • Technician roster and recoverySaved names replace generic Lead and allocation labels across menus and reports, multiple OT Support technicians can be added, and Daily Tasks recover on the same phone for 16 hours. Older active drafts preserve completed core work by assigning it to its original allocation during migration.
  • PM and escalation trackingProcess-filtered Process, Machine, and Vision fields, Completed By selection, automatic completion on save, 50-point scoring, and compact saved lists with Edit and Delete controls reduce scrolling.
  • Compact shift reportingThe screenshot-ready Shift Report shows Date, Shift, completion, earned and missed points, work contribution, top contributor, that leader's PM/Error Proofing/escalation counts, missed-work totals, and PM/escalation totals. The same concise report can be copied, shared, printed, or saved as PDF.
  • Mobile organizationDaily Tasks use collapsible numbered sections, per-section point summaries, Expand All, Collapse All, Incomplete Only, missing-attribution highlighting, and a sticky shift-progress display. The TOP badge and report spacing are optimized for clean phone screenshots.
  • Production copy toolsPKG Update, LNS IQ Check, Cell Recognition Rate, L&S Top 3 NG, and Escalation Format produce copy-ready updates with draft recovery and mobile-friendly previews.
  • Guides and troubleshootingSearchable mobile Work Instructions and process-aware Troubleshooting cover LNS, PKG, Cell Tracking, and EOL using privacy-cleaned historical records and English technical translations.
  • App experienceThe standalone PWA includes Technician sign-in protection, theme-matched V icons, multiple visual themes, English/Korean interface support, and rotating quotes. The unreliable No Response screenshot scanner was removed while the scheduled manual No Response check remains.
